summary: Plan distributor campaigns, manage MDF controls and measure channel activity. Explore the five-day course outline and build practical campaign skills.
lede: Distribution channel marketing brings campaign planning, partner activity and measurement together across indirect routes to market. For channel marketers, distributor marketing leads and sales enablement professionals, it covers audience segmentation, co-marketing briefs and market development fund controls. You’ll also plan lead handoffs and use UTM conventions and channel scorecards to review campaign activity and contribution.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, coordinate or evaluate marketing activity delivered through distributors and other indirect partners.
prerequisites: This intermediate course suits you if you have working familiarity with marketing, distributor sales or channel operations. No coding is required. You should be ready to work with basic campaign and sales information, such as target audiences, leads, budgets and outcomes.
